Armed 2026-10-25 (operator directive: "It needs to work without grant. It's a perpetual grant."; arming packet I.3/I.4): armed=true, status ACTIVE, the weekday 12:00 + 18:00 and weekend every-three-hours (Saturday 06:00 through Sunday 21:00) schedule in windows[] (see schedule_note); 08:00 stays disabled. validate_policy requires the 18:00 canary enabled whenever any window is. canary._note: Arming finding 8. When true, AND the host delegation carries "phase": "canary", an operator at the host TTY may run release_window.py train-run --live --force-window 1800 --operator-forced --operator-ref <ref> --forced-n <n> outside the 18:00 window. It overrides ONLY the window timing; every other gate applies. Shipped false; flipped true by the reviewed arming packet I.4 PR 3 (merged only after Phase 5 shadow passed and the operator said so).

schedule_note: 2026-10-25 operator: "I need it to run at around 12:00 p.m. and the schedule on the weekend should be different. It should run if there's something in the queue every three hours because the weekend will be the heaviest development." and "On the weekends, on Saturdays and Sundays, starting at 6:00 a.m., releases should be every three hours. If there's nothing there, then nothing gets released." and "Yes, it can run overnight until 3:00 a.m. Sunday morning. The market does not open until 6:00 a.m. in the US." Weekdays (mon-fri): 12:00 and 18:00 ET. Weekend: every three hours from Saturday 06:00 through Sunday 21:00 (sat 06, 09, 12, 15, 18, 21; sun 00, 03, 06, 09, 12, 15, 18, 21 ET). No Saturday 00/03 (Friday night), no Monday 00/03. A window runs only when something is eligible (an empty selection is a quiet NO_OP: no alert, no message). days absent = every day. The policy schedules; the host delegation authorizes the slot ids (a live train needs both).

shadow._note: Phase 5 shadow (2026-10-23, DSN-20261021-release-train-P5-T1). Read by release_train_controller.shadow_policy() for SHADOW requests only; a live controller never reads it. integrate: merge the frozen members in an isolated per-slot scratch worktree (~/.cache/rtc/shadow-<slot>/wt, a worktree of the release checkout) and regenerate once, so the shadow report names a real candidate SHA; nothing is pushed. local_test: also run the local test worker on the candidate (off: the full suite is heavy; CI qualifies the candidate anyway). past_window_rules: when a 06:00 drain or 08:00 macro-calendar / latest-start rule would make a live train skip, record it as LIVE_WOULD_REFUSE and rehearse the rest of the pipeline. Any value other than true is off (fail closed).

rules.reason: Changes the train's own controller, classifier, policy, queue store or contracts. A candidate may not modify the verifier that qualifies it.
rules.next_action: Release through the manual process with an operator release grant; the train never carries it.

rules.reason: Broker / Active Trader code is always held (the more restrictive rule wins over any hot-path eligibility).
rules.next_action: Needs an execution-engineering grant and a manual release; the train never carries it.

rules.reason: AGENTS / policy text and agent adapters are operator-ratified.
rules.next_action: Operator ratification per AGENTS.md section 20; a ride approval does not ratify policy.
Operator ride approval bound to the full head SHA.

rules.reason: Guard, push-budget or CI enforcement surface.
rules.next_action: Operator ride approval bound to the full head SHA; guard surfaces are operator-applied patches.

rules.reason: Scheduler, workflow or live-list authority (cron freeze; n8n stage and allowlist).
rules.next_action: Operator ride approval; cron and systemd changes stay operator decisions (AGENTS.md section 17).

rules.reason: Database migration or DDL. Code rollback does not reverse a migration.
rules.next_action: The operator applies the migration; a ride approval does not authorize it.

deletions.reason: Deletes a path. Never delete: archive with a tripwire (AGENTS.md section 0 rule 6).

size.reason: Oversized change (generated files are not counted).

semantic_config.protected_reason: A semantic config change touches a live switch, stage, grant or secret key.

import_closure._note: Reverse Python-import closure built with scripts/lib/test_impact.py's resolver (edges=imports; imports_and_refs adds its string path references, which reach almost everything through scripts/api_v2.py). A change reachable from a protected file inherits that file's class, so a harmless-looking path cannot launder a protected change. Only explicit rule classes propagate; an unclassified importer does not.
